en: Aye, like I said, that's\ra rough opponent.\fDoesn't this old sea dog deserve\rsome smooth sailing now and then?\f
Ahoy there, Eagle.\fIt's time for you to test the waters.\fBattle Orange Star yourself and see\rif my theory holds any water.\f
He's not such a bad guy...\rBut, boy, is he stubborn.
I saw his face! That\rhad to be Andy, but...\f
You... you're Sonja from\rYellow Comet.\fWhat are you doing here?\f
It wasn't Andy who attacked you.\rIt was someone else.\f
Do you know something\rabout all of this?\f
Yes, I do.\fI'll tell you who's pulling all of\rour strings if you'll follow me.\f
I know what you're worried about.\rGo ahead and go with her.\f
I'll take care of Green Earth\rfor you, don't worry.\fThat's what shipmates\rare for, right?\f
I like the idea of getting a closer\rlook at the Orange Star Army.\fI'll meet you again later.\fWatch yourself, Eagle!\f

Olaf's invasion of Orange Star\ris where all of this began.\fDuring the attack, Andy was seen\rleading sorties on several countries.\fYou saw him yourself, didn't you?\fSo... doesn't all this strike\ryou as exceedingly odd?\f
You see what I'm getting at? It\rwould've been impossible for Orange\fStar to launch multiple offensives\rwhile trying to repel Olaf's attack.\fThat's the anomaly I wanted\rto show you.\f
Impossible!\rI'm getting angrier by the moment!\f
It seems that our mystery foe has\rthe ability to create human clones.\fI think it's safe to say that we've\rencountered several copies of Andy.\f
I have some more stones to\roverturn, so I'll be going.\fWhat are your plans?\f
I won't leave this madman\ron the loose!\fI'll find him and crush him!\f
It's up to you then, Eagle!\rHail the Prince of the Skies!\fGood luck!\f
No way I'm losing to a fake me!
That was Andy's clone? Wow... It\rwas a powerful opponent.
We owe it all to Eagle!
I've finally got our foe by the tail.\fI need you to convey some intel\rto Andy and his friends.\f
And what are you gonna\rbe doing in the meanwhile, darlin'?\f
I need to survey the situation.\fDon't worry, I won't do\ranything foolish.\fFather warned me to take care.\f
You wouldn't be trying to pull\rthe wool over my eyes, would you?\f
Of course not.\fYou'll go, won't you?\f
Well, I reckon I have to.\fStay put now, I'll be right back.\f
There's no way I'm losing to this guy!
If we don't stop this enigma\rsoon, Eagle might...
So... you're the one\rbehind all this chaos.\fDo you have a name, or\rshould we just call you Disaster?\f
Well Sturm, we've finally\rhunted you down.\fTime to pay the piper, as they say.\f
Hunted down? Me?\fYou've done nothing but enter\rthe door that I opened for you.\f
Did you think I didn't\rnotice you, little girl?\fYou and your pathetic strategy\rgames! Is that all you're good for?\f
What? But... that's...\ryou couldn't...\fAre you saying you've\rknown all along?\f
You've made one stupid\rmistake after another...\fDid you imagine yourself a match\rfor me? You conceited fool!\fIt's time to put an end to this farce.\rTime to pay the piper, was it?\f
Andy! I wanted to face you\rone more time.\fLet's go!\f
I've got more where that came from!
He's not such a bad guy...\rbut he's so stubborn.
That was a piece of cake!
My strategy was merely better...\rThat is all.
Who would have thought you could\roppose me?
There's nothing left for me to tell\ryou. Congratulations, graduate!
As you complete battles, your rank\rwill rise. This is a special card that\fallows you to check your ranking\rat any time. Congratulations!\f
